title: Kadhal Pagadai
description: Kadhal Pagadai revolves around middle-class families in Konar Colony, in Chennai, in the late 1990s. The show showcases the struggles revolving in middle-class families and the youngsters love live, through emotional outbursts, with comic reliefs here and there. Though there is no main characters, the story mainly revolves around a family living in Konar Colony. The family is led by Mohanbabu, a clerk in a government office, though his wife Vanja is the one leading the family as the only woman. Mohanbabu younger brother, Rajbabu, is a clerk in a chit fund company. He has a girlfriend named Sithara, who is an orphan. Rajbabu hides this fact from his family, as he want to settle first before marrying Sithara. But Sithara's flashback from her college days involving Ramana, forces Rajbabu to introduce her to his family, and his elder sister, Girija gets an instant dislike for Sithara. Girija comes down to Chennai from Saudi, seeking money from her brothers, to release her husband from jail back in Saudi. At the same time, Rajbabu losses the chitfund money, due to a sinister plan laid by his office peon, Sanjeevi. Ramana comes forward to offer money to help Rajbabu and Sithara but has a condition that Sithara should stay with him in his Cunnor Estate for 10 days. If Sithara stills loves Rajbabu after their mutual stay, Ramana would not trouble them anymore. Having faith in Sithara and desperately in need for money, Rajbabu convinces a reluctant Sithara to go with Ramana. But soon, his faith turns into a possessive behavior and Rajbabu refuses to trust Sithara. Though, this is the main gist of the plot, Kadhal Pagadai also revolves around other families in the Colony. One such family is the ultra rich and arrogant woman who bought the house that she stayed in. A strict old man with 2 daughters, who is the only man in the colony to have a telephone, which irritates him as he has to pass messages to the people in the colony. His elder daughter, Nandhini who loves her neighbour, a mechanic and the duo runs away when her father opposes. A Palakad Brahmin family, who is one of the main comic relief in the show. A disabled helper around the colony, named Ayyappan. A struggling cinema actor, also a fraud, with whom Sithara's friend Sundari was in love with, but breaks up after knowing his fraudulent nature. How all these families overcome their daily challenges? Would Ramana win Sithara's heart? Or would Rajbabu and Sithara unite again? forms the climax.

title: UNZIPPED: An Autopsy of American Inequality
description: Feature doc about the growing affordable housing crisis in America. Filmmakers follow families in iconic Venice CA 90291 while investigating plans for a controversial new homeless shelter.

title: Strong Girl Nam-soon
description: Gifted with superhuman strength, a young woman returns to South Korea to look for her birth family - only to be entangled in a drug case that could test her power and strength.

title: Ultimatebeat: Too Much to Lose
description: The story of one online poker site that defrauded its customers for years. When caught, nobody is arrested, indicted or convicted and the fraudsters paid back far less than they stole.

title: Shanthi Nilayam
description: The story revolves around a well known hospital called Shanthi Nilayam and the doctors working in it. The problems surrounding the personal lives of the doctors and the hardships faced by them at the workplace are portrayed very well with different narration.

title: Sju Kammers - Frontsøstrene
description: In Purcells opera Dido and Aenaes, Dido ends her own life with the words "Remember me, but forget my faith." Solace embodies this lament with women silenced by war, united in a choice they made when they were young. Through separate chapters we meet six women who once worked as Red Cross nurses at the Eastern Front. During WWII thousands of European women volunteered to the war zones to serve as nurses for the German Red Cross. In the front lines they cared for wounded German soldiers - and soldiers of other nationalities. These women became known as the Front sisters. On the journey back home after the war had ended they survived through a war-harried Germany. Many returned traumatised and would be socially harassed by their community. In Norway they were imprisoned for treason, condemned for saving the wrong lives. Solace is a film about young women who went out with a desire to help, for later to be associated with some of the most gruesome acts of the twentieth century. At the end of the road they finally dare to reveal some of their innermost painful memories, letting us in to their long-time secrete rooms for the first time.

title: Vasantham Vanthachu
description: Kumaresan (Venkat Prabhu) is a milk vendor in his village, who hates the marriage and stays away from women. His elderly father (Velu Thigal) wants him to get married as soon as possible, but the Kumaresan stubbornly refuses to get married. During the college holidays, the city girl Gayathri (Nanditha Jennifer) comes to stay with her grandparents Chettiar (Shanmugasundaram) and Meenakshi (Varalakshmi). After initial clashes between Kumaresan and Gayathri, Gayathri is intrigued by its refusal to get married. In the past, Kumaresan's brother got secretly married to a woman from a rich family. Kumaresan's family welcomed him and were happy for them. The young Kumaresan clashed with his sister-in-law, therefore the young couple left their home. Kumaresan fell sick after the departure of the couple, then Kumaresan and his father begged Kumaresan's brother to call on their mother (Sabitha Anand) but his sister-in-law refused to let him go. Before she died, Kumaresan's mother Chellamma asked Kumaresan to not be like his brother and to stay with his father. That day, Kumaresan took the decision of remaining single. Meanwhile, Gayathri falls in love with Kumaresan. Gayathri then tied the mangala sutra to herself and lied to the villagers that Kumaresan is the one who tied the knot. Gayathri's grandparents and Kumaresan's father agree for their marriage. Kumaresan doesn't want to live with her, so he tries several ways to drive Gayathri out of his house. Afterwards, the village doctor Rajasekhar (Ramji), who knows about the matter, establishes the truth at the village court and the couple split up. Gayathri then goes to back to her parents. Kumaresan, who felt alone, realises that he was in love with Gayathri but it was too late. The film ends with Gayathri returning to his home and they immediately get married.

title: Once Upon a Small Town
description: A city veterinarian moves to the countryside where he meets a policewoman, a town insider with a friendly secret.

title: M
description: M is a work of art that explores the relationship between sexuality and death. These two appear to be opposite forces, but in fact they merge in all of us, disguising the fear of death or the desire to die, the world of Eros and Thanatos. In M the character of Marilyn Monroe should be seen as a symbol of this interpenetration. The actress's death is as famous as her sexuality and thus sets a perfect example of how the ancient bond between sex and death is being forever mystified and exploited by the popular culture. M attempts to explore this phenomenon in a much more personal level. All the events in the work are fictional and they are set in no particular place or time. The work consists of film material that has been produced on and off in a time period of four years, beginning in March 2013 to December 2017. The footage was shot mainly in the home and grounds of Casa das Musas Art House in Nazare, Portugal. Other shooting locations were Litibu village in Mexico and Uusikaupunki, Finland. All the actors in the work are non-professionals and were chosen because of their strong essence and character. Although the work is based on a script the roles and events were adjusted to fit the actors presence, and all of the dialogue was acted by the artist herself as voiceover. At times the process of filming was on the verge of improvisation and therefore only the afterwork would fully determine how some of the scenes developed. This way of working turned out to be a crucial element of the work. M is not an attempt to tell a story or redefine a character. In fact it is quite the opposite. The elements of film are being used as pathways for the artist to move in and out of the characters, each character representing somewhat a side of the artists own fantasy. By placing herself in the part of an object of fantasy the artist strives to understand the unity of sex and death, not merely as a myth in popular culture, but as an integral part of humanity.

title: M
description: Diane and Tim, a young American couple, give up their search for Tim's father in Patagonia only to encounter a local con man, Alejandro, who lures them back into their journey. title: M
description: M is a gripping family portrait, a poignant tribute to Nicolas Prividera's mother and a thoroughly absorbing historical document that questions the feasibility of arriving at an absolute truth and the validity of any one version of history.

title: M+M
description: Margarita is a ballet dancer. She lives alone with her two sons since her husband died a few years ago. She has a great opportunity for a big performance but unfortunately because of an accident she won't be able to dance. The man,who she blames for the accident,will move to the house next to hers. That man is Mihalis,a rock musician,who lives with his three daughters. Margarita is really upset with her new neighbor and will try to make him leave.

title: #Jestem M. Misfit
description: Julia's life is wonderful. He lives in the United States, goes to a great school, sings and runs a popular online channel. Just an "american dream". One day, when her parents decide to return to Poland, everything will change. Julia will have to find herself in a new school - Millennium High School, ruled by "teams": athletes, nerds, vloggers, musicians, fans of a beautiful look and VIP, led by the self-righteous Victoria. Together with Magenta, the school's outsider, and Kuba, the unfulfilled musician, they will create a group of the excluded. An annual music competition will be held at school soon, in which the winners will be a scholarship and a trip to the United States. Julia cannot miss this opportunity.

title: Mama/M.A.M.A.
description: From the Academy Award[TM]-nominated and Emmy Award[TM]-winning producer of "Waco: The Rules of Engagement" and the Academy Award[TM]-nominated writer/director of "Death on the Job" comes "Mama/M.A.M.A.: Munchausen Syndrome by Proxy." "Mama/M.A.M.A." is the provocative investigation of Munchausen Syndrome by Proxy, a perplexing psychological disorder where a mother secretly but deliberately harms her child in order to get the sympathy and praise of others and the attention of the medical community. What emerges over three years of scrutiny are disturbing questions related to the medical profession's arrogant use of the diagnosis, the possible contribution from the pharmaceutical industry, and its grievous impact on families. Questions addressed in this film include: Is this syndrome an authentic phenomenon or is it a witch hunt? What are the moral implications of a society that fails to question the science behind the disorder, blindly lending faith to its sensational existence? The deeply disturbing "Mama/M.A.M.A." closely follows three cases, allowing the audience to absorb all points of view and determine who the real abusers are. (Florida Film Festival)

title: Bilder (m)einer Mutter
description: A seemingly entirely normal childhood in the 80s, captured on countless video cassettes. On them a family in which each one plays their own role. But there's a shadow on everyday life. With his camera the father calmly documents how in between christmas celebrations and school events the mother becomes more and more of a shadow of herself. At first she disappears from the recordings, later on from the family all together. Father, brother and sister are left and the family construct crumbles. With her film the director callenges her family to break their decades-long silence concerning the loss of the mother. A diary is found, as well as the father's old super 8-recordings, in which the mother still smiled into the camera lovingly. We emerge into the life story of Gaby, who dreams of leaving the bavarian small town and her old school parents as a teenager. Despite the revolutionary cliché of the 70s, marriage is the only logical way to independence for the couple. The climate of the time, torn between emancipation and a conservative way of though, rubs off on the biography of the young woman. Images from society and politics show plenary chambers filled by men and planes with no female pilots in sight. Gabi struggles with the realization of her dreams while her husband lives out a successful career. The camera joins a woman on her tragic life's path, who ultimately stumbles over her role as mother, which she never fully took on.

title: Generation Wolf
description: Generation Wolf talks about a young entrepreneur who is about to lose his business and choose to grow marijuana as an easy way to save it. But soon enough he realizes that crossing the line could have extreme consequences into his life.

title: I'm Not Gay
description: A comedic short film about two guys refusing to confess their sexual attraction towards each other.

title: Giati m' egateleipses
description: Under the pretence of creating a better future for his impecunious wife and his son, an insensitive father cruelly abandons them in high hopes of striking it rich. Will he find the strength to admit his grave mistake, and return to them?

title: I'm Sorry
description: A seemingly-confident comedy writer, wife and mom comically exposes her inner immaturity and neuroses through unexpected life situations.

title: Hippocampus M 21th
description: The word "Hippocampus" was inspired by the hippocampus, a part of the brain located in the temporal lobe, which plays a key role in the learning process and in the formation of new memories about events lived. It is the hippocampus, which connects all the different parts of an experience to form an episodic memory. The letter M is a tribute to "M - The Monster of Dusseldorf" the film by Fritz Lang inspired crimes committed in Germany in the Twenties. The number "21th" references the period in which the film is set, the twenty-first century: the monsters of today. Apartment 37413 Once a week three crazy brothers meet to relive their childhood disorder eating human raw organs and living a sadomasochistic rapport/intercourse... Apartment 28513 The torture of Barbie. A man enjoys torturing and scarring Barbie, but one day he'll decide to do it with real women... Apartment 13396 A painter uses his blood and his muse's faces to prepare the perfect colors for his masterpiece... Apartment 1932301 A woman is looking for a way to becomes excited and she'll discover it touching/with the contact of insects and cockroaches... Apartment 121197 A self-destructive necromancer conserves the mummified corpse of his husband and every night she has sex with it... Apartment 7428M An erotomaniac obsessed by a clown who is in his house blowing up balloons and exploding it.

title: Lilian M.: Relatório Confidencial
description: Maria, a countrywoman, leaves for São Paulo, where she becomes an industrialist's lover and meets all kind of people but, dissatisfied, she returns to the country to meet her family again.

title: Rocketship X-M
description: An astronaut crew on their way to the Moon are unexpectedly propelled by gravitational forces and end up on Mars instead.

title: I'm Haunted 2
description: A woman who watched the Genesis Brady videos from the first I'm Haunted movie attempts to summon the same entity herself to determine whether or not it was a hoax.

title: Dad, I'm Waiting
description: A young daughter patiently waits for her busy father, hoping to spend time with him. As the distance between them grows, the story explores the importance of family, love, and the moments that matter most.

title: I'm Her Most Dangerous Obsession
description: To save her father, Alice works for Daniela Brown, a ruthless mafia queen. A desperate deal turns into a storm of secrets, danger and desire, as Alice becomes the only person capable of breaking through Daniela's cold armor.

title: S&M Hunter
description: When the all-girl gang, The Bombers, kidnap a man to use as their personal sex slave, S&M Hunter accepts the mission to infiltrate The Bombers' hideout and show them the ropes.

title: 40M²
description: A portrait of life during the pandemic made by those who live in the poorest neighborhoods of São Paulo. Two hundred short films united to form four thematic episodes.

title: I'm with Me
description: Days before Valentine's day and their wedding, Cindy Hunter, editor-in-chief of a tabloid and Damon Tuckland, a successful therapist encounter a strange plant that magically puts Cindy's mind in Damon's body and vice versa. Now the couple really finds out how the other half lives. In a series of comic mishaps at work, with relatives and at home, Cindy and Damon must become better people and figure out a way to reverse the "awkward" situation before their wedding or face a lifetime as each other. It's the ultimate body-swapping comedy with a heart that gives a brand-new meaning to the term "The Opposite Sex".

title: M-Theory
description: Movie is based on M-theory the last research of Albert Einstein in which a young professor and researcher Devdhar Mukherjee is trying to find the meaning of M, God and existence simultaneously coping up with the suicide of his father who was a scientist researching on M -theory and unexpected death of his mother who was a believer of God his parents died when he was only 8 years old. Devdhar is on the quest to find the meaning of M-theory. This movie deals with 11 dimensions of universe, concept of God, Life and Death explained in scientific and spiritual way.

title: N/949
description: A drug-abuse tragedy affected to Marco, Luka's best friend. Luka felt guilty about that. That's why he decided to begin an outsider lifestyle in a society where nobody can breath.

title: The Covenant S1-S2

title: Dust n' Bones
description: Dust 'n Bones brings to light the legal, political, historical and spiritual challenges faced by First Nations leaders and archaeologists as they fight to give disinterred ancestors their proper reverence.

title: Bldg. N
description: A college student, Shiori, visits an abandoned apartment complex in a provincial city, which is famous for its rumors of hauntings, out of curiosity along with Keita and Maho, who also attend the university. However, there are numerous residents there. As Shiori and her friends begin to investigate, they suddenly experience a violent "bizarre rap phenomenon" and a resident jumps to his death right in front of them.

title: Otis N' Dwayne
description: Two androgynous creatures embark on a psychotronic journey of self-discovery in a cruel, unusual, mostly male world in this dark comedy about two gay androids abandoned in a New Jersey suburb inhabited by God, the devil, and other lowlifes.

title: Beat n Path
description: This docu-series follows Lupe Fiasco, a Grammy award winning rapper from Chicago, as he drops everything to embark on a cross-cultural journey across China to live out his other passion - martial arts. Dubbed the "King of Lyrical Trickiness," Lupe applies his skill for lyrical flow to the movements of kung fu, joining the world's greatest martial arts masters as they teach Lupe their secrets. Lupe also takes the opportunity to explore China's hip hop scene and record his next hit, Air China, a song inspired by his journey and experience.

title: Rock 'n' Roll
description: Passionate rock'n roll dancer, Rodolfo has his partner Ornella as a partner. Frozen by the frivolous behavior of the boy, however, the young girl no longer wants to learn to dance with him.

title: Rob N Roll
description: Decadent Murong Hui teams up with violent bandits after a botched robbery. A female detective pursues them as they scheme to steal a bag of money, leading to chaotic events due to betrayals and twists under the "I rob, you rob me" code.

title: Nelsons N 5
description: World-renowned conductor Andris Nelsons, music director of the Boston Symphony Orchestra, arrives in Amsterdam to conduct Shostakovich's powerful 5th Symphony before the city's renowned Royal Concertgebouw Orchestra.

title: Kit N Sam
description: Sam and Kit have been a faithful couple going-steady for two years. They get engaged. About a week before their marriage, Kit comes up with a proposition, which she thinks will keep their marriage a success forever. She tells Sam that till marriage they should go out and taste the forbidden fruit of infidelity, so that they don't have any desire for other men/women after marriage - after much hesitation, Sam agrees to her proposal A hilarious turn of events ensue through the misadventures of Kit and Sam as they go about trying to have affairs with other men and women - until they realize what true love is.

title: Eggs 'n' Baker
description: Saturday morning children's cookery series, presented by Cheryl Baker.

title: Salt n' Pepper
description: The story of a few foodies, whose fondness of food bonds them together.

title: B'hike n BASE
description: This adventure is a unique experience, a journey that combines cycling and base Jump which has never been done before. Adventurer and base jumper Francky Malleus who is 27 and from France, will spend a month and a half on his bike carrying only his camping gear and base jumping equipment on his cargo rack to go jump from the cliffs of the Alps.

title: Fame N Fishin'
description: Fishing guide Robin Rebman and singer songwriter Earl 'Peanutt' Montgomery take country music stars for fishing, conversation and singalongs along the Tennessee River.

title: Zone(n)050
description: In Ledeberg - "Police zone 050" - there is a group of young people that met each other at Keizerpark or Centrumplein. Some say they are drug users, dealers, or commit crimes - A one sided story. In zone(n)050 these young people get a voice to tell us their side of the story. About the problems they have had to deal with, about how difficult it can be to grow up and stay on the right path, and about their dreams. Still one sided, but just as true. Zone(n)050 is a documentary about suns, sometimes absent fathers and amazing mothers.

title: King 'n' Me
description: An eccentric millionaire sends a documentary film crew on a search to find the most legendary icon in the history of rock n roll...The King. Is he alive, as many believe? If so, does he want to be found? Is there any credibility to the often ridiculous tales of sightings? What they soon find will not only change their careers, but also their lives.

title: Nikki & Nora: The N&N Files
description: The N&N Files follows New Orleans locals Nikki Beaumont (Liz Vassey) and Nora Delany (Christina Cox) as they juggle the inner-workings of their personal lives with their roles as private investigators in America's oldest party town.

title: Black n White
description: The murder of two politicians of the ruling party creates a lot of chaos in state politics. During the investigation, police get a lead about the biggest drug racket in North East India.

title: Ed, Edd n Eddy
description: The off-the-wall, day-to-day life of three friends who have exactly the same name.

title: Lance N' Masques
description: Yotaro Hanafusa is a descendant of the "Knights of the World." With the Knight's Code of Chivalry hammered into him since childhood, Yotaro cannot stop himself from saving damsels in distress. He wears a mask, and is known on the street as "Knight Lancer" but he has always kept his identity a secret. While on an outing, Yotaro saves a 6-year-old girl, Makio Kidoin, the only child of a powerful business tycoon. When Yotaro discovers that Makio leads a lonely life in a huge estate, he resolves to protect her. He and his friends disguise themselves as lodgers and move into her mansion.

description: Unable to tell a lie, a young man is struggling to keep a job. Could his beautiful but blind next-door neighbour inspire change in his life?

title: O stohos
description: A journalist is investigating the severe conditions that result in polluting the atmosphere. He turns against wealthy and unscrupulous men who control the chemical factories. The most powerful of them happens to have an erotic relationship with our hero's ex-wife. One day while doing his TV-show concerning the environmental conditions, he dares to say the truth and soon he ends up imprisoned. When he is released, he does the same, until he pays the price.

title: O Fim e o Princípio
description: A film starting from naught. With no prior research, no characters, no sites, nor specific themes, a film team arrive to the hinterland of Paraíba state in northeastern Brazil in search of people with stories to tell. In the village of São João do Rio do Peixe they come to Sítio Araçás, a rural community of 86 families, mostly relatives. With a girl from Araçás as mediator, the residents, in their majority, elderly, tell their life story, marked by popular catholicism, by a hierarchy, by a sense of family and honor - in a world fast disappearing.

title: O Beijo

The architect obliges out of compassion, but people don't understand his gesture, and he soon becomes the talk of the town, and not in a good way.

title: O Teri

A heart patient, Manohar has an ambitious wannabe model in his son Nacchi (Zulfi Syed) who is lost in the bliss of the big city. When he suffers another nearly fatal stroke, Nacchi reluctantly returns to be by his dying father's side. Seizing the opportunity, the dying man manages to knot the innocent village belle Mallige to our dear city chap. As much as Nacchi hates the decision, he goes along considering his father's health. He even manages to consummate the wedlock under the influence of alcohol. A few days later the old man dies leaving the helpless girl to his son. The very next day Nacchi leaves her who has nowhere to turn for support. Days roll by and soon Mallige realizes she is expecting a baby. To take things under her own control she decides to join her absconding husband in the city. Nachi changing his name as Naresh Patel has shifted base to city and is shown wooing the rich daughter (Chaitali) of a millionaire (Avinash) to fuel his aspirations of becoming a successful model. Soon the young couple is shown exchanging sweet nothings in parks and restaurants while the pregnant girl is roaming the streets of the city looking for her ignorant husband. Krishna Murthy alias Kitti (Ramesh) who is also an aspiring model in between odd jobs. An accident brings Kitti and Mallige together as she is seriously injured in the mishap and loses all memory of her immediate past. For his convenience to shoo off the prying landlords, Kitti brings Mallige to his house and christens her Lakshmi since she has no memory of her name. A special bond of affection starts forming between the two. Nacchi continues his Casanova ways with the rich girl unaware of any of these happenings. Lakshmi bears a child and names him Ganesha. Meanwhile, Kitti manages to get a plum offer from the same firm that works with Mallige's husband. Soon Nacchi as his girlfriend realizes that he is married and so starts encouraging Kitti instead to get back at him. Nacchi confronts her and ends up apologizing for his "mistake" but she is firm in her decision and decides not to have anything to do with him. Things start falling into place when she sees Mallige at Kitti's place and informs him about the truth. Kitti is heartbroken at the thought of losing Mallige to a stranger. title: It's Showtime
description:
Kung may isang alamat na hindi nakakasawang balik-balikan, ito 'yung alamat na masarap panoorin habang sila'y kumakanta at nagsasayawan. None other than P-Pop group, ALAMAT, na nagbabalik ang grupo sa 'It's Showtime' studio para i-perform ang Luzviminda,

Walang basaan dito pero bubumuhos ang swerte at good vibes kasama ang mga taga-San Juan City (na kilala sa 'Wattah Wattah' Festival) sa 'Laro Laro Pick' game arena.

Naglaro rin sina Teddy Corpuz, Darren Espanto, Jackie Gonzaga at Ryan Bang. Si Jackie lang ang nakatawid sa 'You Gotta Lyric,' kung saan tama naman ang sagot niya, pero pabirong idineklarang "wrong" ni Jhong Hilario dahil sintunado. To the rescue naman si Darren para itama ang tono! Dackie moment na ‘to!

Samantala, na-touch ang Showtime hosts sa kuwento ng buhay ni Wo, isang delivery rider na laki sa lolo. Habang itinataguyod ang sariling pamilya, gusto rin niyang maibalik ang sakripisyo ng lolong nagpalaki sa kanya. Samantala, 'extra' ang banter nina Kim Chiu at Jhong na nauwi pa nga sa dilatan ng mga mata. At syempre, kanya-kanya silang entry ng jokes tungkol sa pangalan ni Wo!

Very good din si Tate, ang tricycle driver na sweet lover kay misis, at may malasakit din sa kapwa. Minsan na niyang pinatunayan ang kabutihan nang ibalik ang gamit na naiwan ng pasahero. Kaya ang madlang girls sa studio, na-in love kay Tate! 'Yun nga lang, si misis, umapela, "Sorry po, married na!"

Luck ay na-attract ni Margo, ang hairstylist na 'di nauubusan ng kuwento. Pati tungkol kina Ogie Alcasid at Anne Curtis, meron siyang 'chismis.' At shoutout sa mga ex niya, hanggang tingin na lang daw kayo sa kan'yang ganda! Umabot sa P35,000 ang Li-Pot offer, na tinanggap ni Margo. Tama ang pinili ate n'yo dahil nang subukan niya ang P350k Pot question, akala niya'y 'simple' lang pero hindi pala niya alam ang kasagutan.

It's time for Region 1 to shine sa second week ng ika-10 taon ng "Tawag Ng Tanghalan."

Ang unang kalahok ay mula Laoag City, si Jeanel Silvestre, na nagpamalas ng husay sa entablado, singing Juan Karlos ‘JK’ Labajo's "Demonyo." Katulad ng idol na si JK, nagsusulat din ng kanta si Jeanel, na bet 'piratahin' ni Ogie nang magustuhan ang sample ng self-composition nito. Speaking of songwriting, may tip si Ogie tungkol d'yan.

Ang awit daw ay hinuhugot sa sariling kuwento, parang si Louie Ocampo, na binuo ang "Tell Me" mula sa sariling karanasan. Binalikan din ng 'Showtime' family ang iba pang iconic songs na nilikha ng maestro. Proud din si Ogie dahil komposisyon ng kanyang kaibigan

ang napiling bagong theme song ng isang airline. Chika niya, isa siya sa napakaraming tinalo ni Sir Louie sa paggawa ng theme song na 'to.

Samantala, napabilib ni Jeanel sina hurado Jonathan Manalo, Bituin Escalante, at Maestro Louie. Para sa kanila, strength ni Jeanel ang pagiging chill nito, at ang magandang tone.

Mula Pangasinan, lumuwas si Shekinah Barbiran to chase her dream sa tanghalan. "Ikaw Ay Ako" ni Klarisse De Guzman ang napili niyang sandata sa laban ng bosesan. At 15, 'beterano' na siya sa pagsali ng contests. Dahil seasoned kontesera, nakita ng hurados ang pagiging relaxed niya.

Nagustuhan ng hurados ang dalawang nagtanghal pero isa lang ang aabante sa susunod na round, at ito ay si Jeanel na nakakuha ng markang 91% laban sa 89.3% ni Shekinah.

title: Okay pa ba 'to? Vice, kinabahan kay Medusa | It's Showtime
description:
Ihanda ang damdamin, musika niya ay damhin. Si "PBB Gen 11" ex-housemate Dylan Yturralde na ang bahala sa kiig playlist mo today. Nagkuwento rin si Dylan tungol sa kanyang music journey at paano siya na-inspire ni OPM icon Rico Blanco.

Sabi nila, respect your elders, kaya saludo tayo sa mga seniors na sa dami ng karanasan ay matatawag na certified life achievers. This Thursday sa Miss Q and A segment ng "It's Showtime," nagkasukatan ng seniority at timeless wit at beauty.

Ang ating senyoritang sosyal at elegante, rumampa sa Miss Q&A, walang iba kundi si Señora Danica Parong Evidente. Sa isang titig niya baka ikaw ay matulala, walang kupas ang karisma ni Medusa Valentina Galema. At kayo na raw ang humusga kung tao ba o hayop si candidate Exotic Tayop.

Biro ng hosts, tatawagin nating "Miss Q and A" Senior Edition ang segment for today's video dahil may twenty percent discount na ang mga 'lola' n'yo. Pero sa kulitan, full price ang tawanan. May aral din na mapupulot tungkol sa mga pangarap na hindi dapat ibaon na lang sa limot. Dahil age is just a number, pero ang 'slayable' attitude will last forever.

Sa pagtitinda ng laruan, bata ang madalas nilang pinasasaya. Pero sa araw na 'to, sila naman ang nabigyan ng ligaya sa game arena. Toy sellers mula NCR ang bumida sa Laro Laro Pick.

Si player Ria, never paglalaruan ang puso ng nobyong si Eric. At never niya itong ipagpapalit kahit kanino, kahit kay Ralph de Leon pa! Biceps at makinis na kutis ni Ralph, hindi umubra!

Dahil walang naka-survive sa mga challenges, bumunot ng lucky player na aabante sa jackpot round, mga bes. Si Liza ang pinabalik sa game arena para sa chance na maiuwi ang malaking kwarta!

title: Vice, tinapatan ang talak nina Andrea at Jers sa Miss Q&A
description:
Dedma sa ex na kumakatok at may pasalubong na paulit-ulit na pasakit. But, hello sa grupong nagbabalik sa "It's Showtime" entablado para pagandahin ang araw n'yo. Napaindak ang buong nation sa performance at taas ng energy ng P-Pop group VXON.

Dazzling sa pagrampa sina Miss Q and A Resbakulawan candidates Andrea Jane Peralta, Jers Sabado, at Mama Dhel. Dahil Resbakulawan, diretso nang sumalang ang tatlo sa Wit Lang. Pagkatapos, sina Andrea at Jers ang umabante sa BEKLAMATION.

Na-impress si hurado Nicole Cordoves, pero aminadong nakulangan nang kaunti sa 'chukchak' ng dalawang ladies. Kaya para iwas-bitin, pati si Vice Ganda ay tumalak na rin! Sa huli, itinanghal na Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era Resbakulawan daily winner si Andrea.

Hindi na kailangan pang tumama sa lotto para masabing lucky sa araw na 'to! Dahil swerte agad ang lumapit sa mga taga-San Isidro, Cainta Rizal na bumida sa Laro Laro Pick game arena sa "It's Showtime."

Walang mapapagod kakatawa sa mga challenges sa game arena. Sa paboritong Act-Song portion sa You Gotta Lyric round, time-out muna sa kilig scenes sina Brent Manalo at Jackie Gonzaga dahil magkapatid muna sila sa isang eksena ng family drama.

Hindi naman horror story ang pagsali ni player Pao. Dahil matapos ma-eliminate, nabunot ang pangalan niya upang maglaro sa jackpot round dahil bigo ang mga naunang players na ma-secure ang spot.

Ramdam ni Vice Ganda ang matinding pangangailangan ni Pao, isang siomai vendor na nag-iipon para sa kanyang operasyon sa mata dahil sa kondisyon na keratoconus. Ramdam din nito ang puso ng manlalaro. Kaya para bang binigyan niya ito ng lakas ng loob na sugalan ang POT question.

Pigil ang hininga ng Madlang People at lahat ng nasa studio, hanggang sa isinigaw ni Pao ang sagot. Bumuhos ang emosyon at saya nang i-anunsyo ni Vice Ganda na tama ang sagot ni Pao at maiuuwi nito ang P350,000 POT money.

title: P@St Forward
description: In 2022, 30-year-old Eliott, an ordinary salesman, writes to his first email address - from when he was ten - to check if it's still available. He's shocked when a reply comes from himself in 2001. As young Eliott listens to his older self's advice and crazy requests in regular emails, he starts to change the future for friends and family, as well as alter the course of his own destiny. Young Eliott tells his parents he's exchanging emails with his future self and gets sent to Dr Sax, a psychologist. Sax sees Eliott's incredible ability to predict the future (everything from 9/11 to new technology) as an endless source of power and money. When Eliott tries to escape his clutches, he finds himself pointing a gun at Sax - both in 2001 and 2022. But which Eliott kills him? Back in 2022, Eliott finally establishes a happy new reality, and everything appears settled. That is until he receives a phone call...from himself in 2042.

title: Trainwreck: P.I. Moms [Hindi]
description: A 2010 Lifetime reality show about soccer mom PIs unravels when investigations fail and sabotage is suspected. The agency head faces accusations of running drugs with a corrupt officer's help.

title: Vhong at Ogie nagkapikunan sa mainit na puksaan
description:
Oooh lala-van na lavan ang pitik ng bewang nina Baby Dolls Arianne, Chloe, Johaira, Juby, Jelai, Eriel, and Ina. To welcome their era as an official P-Pop group at kauna-unahang Hype Group ng bayan, ginanap ang Baby Dolls Day.

Present ang mga social media personalities, Kapamilya at Kapuso "PBB" ex-housemates, beauty queens, P-Pop groups, "Tawag Ng Tanghalan" alumni, "Showtime Online U" hosts, at All-Star Games Basketball at Volleyball Team para makigiling.

Pagkatapos ng Baby Dolls Day celebration, bumida naman ang beki na may talak para sa buong nation. Meet CY ng Quezon City, Fema Braganza ng Pangasinan, at BRIGIT ng Laguna, ang mga talakera na sumubok masungkit ang korona sa Miss Q and A.

Minsan ang talak, may pagka-harsh, parang comment ni Ogie Alcasid, na hindi inurungan sa puksaan si Vhong Navarro. Kaya ang ilong ni Vhong, napuruhan sa laitan!

Naloka naman ang Madlang People sa sagot ng mga kandidata sa unang tanong sa Tumpak Ganern tungkol sa karakter sa Noli Me Tangere na sinasabing ama ni Maria Clara. Ang sagot ni BRIGIT, "Nutridamus!" Kaya biro ni Vice Ganda, kapatid ba 'yan ni Nutri Bun?

Sina Fema at CY ang umabante sa next round ng chukchakan, ang Wit Lang. Pagkatapos ng talakan, ang very 'pulchritudinous', sabi ni Brent Manalo, na si CY ang kinoronahan bilang Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era of the day.

Pumadyak ang swerte at good vibes para sa mga pedicab driver na sumalang sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Nakaka-touch ang pagiging solid Showtimer ni Tatay Doms, na may iniabot pang liham ng pasasalamat para kay Vice Ganda at sa buong "It's Showtime" family. Pero, si Kim Chiu, nagtampo, dahil wala ang pangalan niya sa sulat na ito.

Pagkatapos ng aktingan, iisa lang ang naka-survive sa laro! Ito ay si Mavin, na kahit mahirap man ang buhay ay nananatiling masayahin. Kapang P300k ang napasakanya, babawi siya sa magulang niya. Pero sapat nang pambawi ang P40,000 na Li-Pot offer kaya dito na siya sa siguradong uuwi siyang panalo.

#ShowtimeBabyDollsDay
#ItsShowtimeFullEpisode 
#ABSCBNEntertainment

title: Todd P Goes to Austin
description: A cultural snap-shot of America's underground, do-it-yourself music scene featuring unforgettable live performances from Matt and Kim, Dan Deacon, Mika Miko, The DeathSet and many more.

title: It's Showtime
description:
Bumilis ang pintig ng puso ng kababaihan sa studio dahil sa pagdating ng mga gwapo. P-Pop group na AJAA, pinakilig ang mga tao, 'yung kilig na may halong kaba kapag si crush ay nasa tabi mo na. They performed their single "Kakabakaba," na perfect background music kapag nakikita ang taong nagpapabilis ng heartbeat mo.

Hindi pwedeng umatras ang mga beki na kinakabahan kapag oras na ng talakan. Panibagong linggo ng Miss Q and A, sinimulan nina Marjorie Lopez Buenaobra, Jov Prado, at Babyloves Monroe Solito.

Astig ang kandidatang si Marjorie na game mag-dance exhibition with buwis-buhay moves. Aray mo, bhie! Doble naman ang pressure na nilabanan ni Babyloves sa entablado dahil sumali na rin ang sa Miss Q and A ang boyfriend niya at umuwing panalo. Kaya biro ni Jhong Hilario, parang 'niraket' ng mag-bebe ang Miss Q and A. 

Sumakses si Marjorie sa unang round at sumalpak sa Wit Lang kung saan nabunot niya ang tanong na, "Bakit tuwalya ang laman ng goto, at hindi bimpo?" Naka-face off niya si Jov na naging witty rin as she 'talak-ed' sa nabunot na question, "Bakit magaan lang ang hibe?" 

Bumuhos ang emosyon sa Laro Laro Pick game arena sa mva kuwento ng katatagan at pagmamahal na ibinihagi ng Madlang Solo Parents mula NCR.

Bumilib ang Madlang People sa laki ng pagmamahal ni Danny sa mga anak, pati sa matibay nitong pananampalataya. Mahirap man daw ang buhay pero sisikapon ng biyudong si Danny na itaguyod ang pag-aaral ng mga anak.

Very beautiful naman ang smile ni Eve sa kabila ng madilim na pinagdaanan sa kamay ng dating asawa. Eh, kung ready na siya na muling buksan ang puso, si Ogie Alcasid may irereto.

Ang swerte ay kumapit kay player Nelle, na hindi rin napigilan ang luha nang ikuwento ang pinagdaanan bilang ina. Matapos umuwi mula Taiwan, kung saan sya nagtrabaho at nanganak, bigla na lang tumigil sa pagsusustento ang ama ng kanyang anak.

Naging praktikal si Nelle at tinanggap ang Li-Pot offer. Tama kaya ang kanyang desisyon? 

#ShowtimeNovemberGV
#ItsShowtimeFullEpisode 
#ABSCBNEntertainment

description: Two East Coast rappers come to Hollywood to be famous movie stars. This musical comedy chronicles this rap duo's raise to the top in this largely improvised season with original music and old school dance featuring the Sugah Pimps. From getting arrested to working for the man, Itty P and DJ Model T show the world just how to make it in LA.

title: Miss Q&A Kyla
description:
Ngayong July 3 and every day, ang tawanan sa "It's Showtime ay free. Kasama ang mga kandidata ng Miss Q and A, ang good vibes ay times three!

Sina Agua ng Parañaque City, Raux Araneta ng Negros Occidental at Kyla ng Laguna, kanya-kanyang paandar sa pagpapakilala sa Madlang People. Pero ang pinakagusto nilang makilala, eh 'di ang mga crush nila! Parang Valentine's season sa buwan ng Hulyo, kilig ng ladies ay todo-todo dahil kina Michael Sager, Ralph de Leon, at Brent Manalo.

Pero hindi lang crush ang kayang nilang ipaglaban, dahil pati sa social issues ay hindi matitinag ang kanilang paninindigan. Syempre, namana nila ang tapang ni Vice Ganda, na hindi matatakot 'ipahiya' ang mga magnanakaw, lalo na 'yung mga sangkot sa flood control scam, kung sakaling makasabay niya ito sa daan. Pero kung guwardiyado ang magnanakaw, teka lang, ibang usapan na 'yan.

Mukhang na-inspire ang mga kandidata kina Michael, Ralph at Brent dahil sa unang round ay mabilis ang kanilang pagpindot at pagsagot. Sina Agua at Raux ang nanguna sa Tumpak Ganern at nag-face off sa Round 2 na Wit Lang.

Parehong magaling! Mga answers nila ay winning! Kaya naman 'it's a tie' ang resulta. Sa araw na 'to, mayroon tayong dalawang Miss Q&A Reyna TalakEra.

Sa pinakabagong inaabangan na 'teleserye' sa tanghalian, ang You Gotta Lyric portion ng Laro Laro Pick, pang-finale ang eksena nina Vice Ganda bilang MemeRimar at Vhong Navarro bilang Sergio.

From aktingan, back to hosting si Vice Ganda upang papiliin si Duday, ang lucky player from Mandaluyong, kung Pot o Li-Pot ba ang desisyon niya. Wala nang patumpik-tumpik pa, Li-Pot offer ay itinodo na! Kaya hindi na rin nagdalawang-isip si Duday, at tinanggap na ang Li-Pot.

Ngunit laking pagsisisi ni Duday dahil nang subukan ang POT question, tama sana ang sagot niya. Pero tulad ng ipinangako ni Vice Ganda, dinagdagan niya ng P5,000 ang papremyo ni Duday sa oras na makasagot ito nang tama.

title: Kandidata, excited MALOTLOT sa Miss Q&A?!
description:
P-Pop rise! Nagdala ng fresh energy sa studio ang 12-member P-Pop group AZTER sa isang hataw at nakaka-LSS na performance ng kanilang kantang “Parang May Mali.”

Positive ang heart, pero dapat mabilis din ang isip dahil sa Miss Q and A, hindi sapat ang confidence at ganda kundi kailangan din ng wit. Nagpakitang-gilas sa talakan sina Tinderella Marie, C-Jay Ubias Tablit, at Serenity Winter.

Para bang na-manifest ni Tinderella ang sariling pagkalotlot dahil nagkatotoo ang sinabi niyang excited siyang “tumalot.” Siya nga ang unang naligwak matapos maunahan ng mga kalaban sa pindutan at sagutan sa Tumpak Ganern round.

Sina Serenity at C-Jay naman ang nag-face off sa Wit Lang, kung saan muling nasubok ang kanilang husay sa pagsagot sa playtime questions.

Umulan naman ng kilig at hiyawan sa studio sa pagpasok ng bagong duo na may hawak ng bowl of questions. Sina Brent Manalo at Ralph de Leon muna ang escorts for today. Para patunayan na deserve nila ang posisyon, daanin sa joke time ang audition.

Laging handa, ‘yan ang motto ng ating mga scout. Kaya sa pagsabak nila sa Laro Laro Pick, walang puwang ang doubt. Boy Scouts of the Philippines ang players for today's video. Ang swerte, sa kanila ba ay sasaludo?

Na-curious si Vice Ganda nang makita ang mga girl sa hanay ng players na bahagi ng Boy Scouts of the Philippines. Sa jackpot round, si Yel ang umabante para sa chance na maiuwi ang P200,000 POT money. Naibigay kaya ni Yel ang tamang sagot at naiuwi ang malaking POT money?

title: Miss Q&A Nunoy
description:
Maligayawang kaarawan, Chief of OPM Ogie Alcasid. Bukod sa "It's Showtime" family, present to celebrate ang nag-iisang reyna sa puso niya, his forever favorite ka-duet, his misis Regine Velasquez. From the heart ang mensahe ni Asia's Songbird sa chief ng kanilang tahanan.

Imbitado rin sa episode ang isa pang hitmaker, Moira dela Torre, na ginulat ang malang people sa mataas niyang energy.

Hit at bentang-benta rin ang witty talak ng tatlong kandidata sa Miss Q and A. Break muna sa pagbubbunot ng ngipin ang dentistang si Dra. Ruth Qanal, at sa chukchakan muna siya humugot ng banat. Ima-mine mo rin ang good vibe na dala ni Dyeyzel Romero, ang live seller talakera. At agaw-eksena ang intro ni Nunoy, na para bang dinala tayo sa liga ng basketball.

Triple treat din ang attendance nina Anne Curtis, Vice Ganda, at Vhong Navarro, na hindi matapos-tapos ang kulitan at bardagulan. Anne is back, and so is her 'bulol' hosting, kaya si Meme Vice ay 'nabuwisit' sa kanyang sabaw moments.

Pati ang hosts nag-enjoy sa mga tanong sa Tumpak Ganern. Ano nga ba sa Ingles ang tanikala? At ang isang bugtong, nasagot ni Anne, but as usual, in a sosyal way nga lang!

Nag-babu nang maaga si doktora, matapos maligwak sa Tumpak Ganern round. Kaya sina Dyeyzel at Nunoy ang umabante sa Wit Lang.

From palengke, napasugod sa game arena ang mga masisipag na tindero't tindera. Pasok, mga suki, swerte ay hitik sa Laro Laro Pick.

Usapang isda muna tayo kasama si nanay Dada, na nag-sample kung paano mag-alok sa mga parokyano at pumaldo nang todo. Ang isa pang sikreto, dapat kilay on fleek upang ang customers ay maakit.

Gulay na madaling itanim at anihin naman ang category sa It's Giving kung saan dalawa lang ang natira. It's Dada versus Mila. Pagdatating sa hulaan ng title ng kanta, parehong olats ang dalawa. Kaya bumunot ng iba, at ang swerte ay kay Mie napunta.

P450,000 ang pwede niyang mapanalunan. Syemmpre, gusto ni Mie 'yan! Pero mas pinili niyang maging praktikal at tanggapin ang Li-Pat offer na P50,000. 'Yun nga lang, alam pala ni Mie ang sagot sa katanungan.

title: Miss Q&A
description:
Sa pag-ibig, maraming tanong na walang kasagutan. Mapapasabi ka na lang ng, "Hindi ko alam." 'Yan ang hugot ng bandang Spongecola at ni Kai Del Rio sa pagsasanib ang kanilang mga musika't talento.

Sa Miss Q and A, talak ay hindi bitin. Busog sa wit ang mga kandidata for today's video, sina Sashi Giggle Esmeralda, Zha-Zha Divah, at Angel Grey, in their rampa and chukchak na havey.

Si Vice Ganda, namasa ang kili-kili sa daming ganap this Wednesday. From bardagulan to kantahan, parang never-ending ang kulitan. Masarap din balikan ang tamis, pati na ang pait, ng unang pag-ibig. Ang usapang crush at rejection, idaan na lang natin 'yan sa karaoke session! Kapag ba galing sa vacay, talagang unlimited ang energy? Ayun, muntik na namang mag-OT sina Meme!

Sa hinaba-haba ng mga pata-WOW, sa Tumpak Ganern round pa rin ang tuloy. Ang comeback-ing kandidata na si Sashi, bigo na pumaslak muli. Samakatuwid, sina Angel at Zha-Zha ang nagsalpukan sa Wit Lang.

Sobrang init ng panahon. Ang haring araw, talagang umeeksena! Pero mas mainit ang swerte sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Mula drawing, magkatotoo kaya ang dream 'winning' ng mga Architecture students mula NCR?

"Woke up like this" ang peg ni Kyle in his kulot-kulutan hairdo. Ano nga ba ang goal niya, and in the future, saan niya balak gamitin ang talento? Kinilala nina Vice Ganda ang Dean's Lister at scholar na 'to! Si Charz naman, eksaherada ang 'sikip' ng "Tala" dance moves with backup dancers! Ang lakas ng 'amats' ng mga estudyante, gigil n'yo tuloy si Meme!

After all that fun, si Charz, ang nag-sample ng “Tala” prod, ang umabante sa jackpot round na para bang may swerteng hatid ang ‘masikip’ na dance moves niya. Umabot ng P30,000 ang Li-Pot offer, na sobra pa sa bayarin sa eskwela.

title: Q N' A with Mikki and Shay
Miss Q&A: Barbie Bratz
description:
Kung may sariling opinyon, 'yan ay karapatan! Basta't may respeto pa rin, huwag matatakot ipahayag ang paninindigan. Nagbabalik ang limang Miss Q and A 'ResBAKS' na sa talakan ay walang inuurungan, sa weekly finals ng Resbakulawan round.

Pare-parehong 'nalotlot' sa unang sabak sa pagtalak, but now they're back stronger and fiercer, still with a dash of laughter. From the daily Resbakulawan, oras na para sa final face-off nina Barbie Bratz Ayuda, Andrea Jane Peralta, Misis Jawo, Miss Mia, at Carla Flores Argonza sa “It’s Showtime” July 25 episode.

Hindi maiwasan ang lutang moments sa unang round. May nabibingi sa tanong, at merong hula-hula lang ang sagot. Si Andrea ang unang naligwak sa laban. Pero bumawi ang candidates sa Wit Lang round.

Pagkatapos ng Wit Lang, sina Barbie Bratz at Carla ang umangat at nagharap sa Beklamation, kung saan pareho silang palaban sa katanungan na, "Ano ang mas gusto mo, maging pride o joy ka ng magulang mo?" Naghatid nga ng pride at joy sa kanyang mga magulang si Carla dahil siya ang kinoronahan bilang Miss Q and A Resbakulawan weekly winner.

Ika'y mapapangiti sa ganda ni Bianca Umali, na guest co-host nina Vice Ganda at Amy Perez sa Laro Laro Pick, July 25 episode ng “It’s Showtime,” kung saan bumida ang mga taga-Don Bosco, Paranaque.

Si Joan ay tumama kaya siya ang umabante sa jackpot round for the chance to win P100,000. Matapang na sinugalan ni Joan ang POT question, ngunit bigo siyang maibigay ang tamang sagot.

Sa dulo ng programa, naglabas ng isang statement si Vice Ganda. Aniya, nakarating sa pamunuan ng "It's Showttime" ang mga komento ng viewers at netizens na na-offend o hindi nagustuhan ang ilang jokes ng hosts, partikular na sa 'Memerimar' episodes sa Laro Laro Pick kaya naman humingi ng dispensa si Vice.

title: Miss Q&A Amara
description:
Maaga ang Pasko feels kasama ang paboritong ‘inaanak’ ng Madlang People at “It’s Showtime” family, ang super talented na si Imogen Cantong. Pero si Imogen ang may handong na aguinaldo—isang sweet na awitin, her new single titled “Para sa Aming Bukas.”

Huwag matakot tumalak and let your voice be heard, katulad ng mga kandidata na hindi susuko hanggang sa makamit ang inaasam na korona.

Meet Amara Nicole Delos Santos, Trixie Gomez, Christian Basmayor Bataller. Salpukan ng wit ay nagtuloy-tuloy sa Wit Lang round. Kung akayo si Christian, paano niya sasagutin ang tanong na, "Anong pakiramdam ng mais na hinahanap-hanap siya sa corned beef?" At, masaya ba ang repolyo kapag tinutusok siya ng hotdog?" naman ang tanong na nabunot ni Trixie.

Ngayong Martes, sino ang ‘yong nami-miss? Ayiieee! Ang tamis! Enjoy the feels, pero make sure na hindi mo mami-miss ang kulitan sa Laro Laro Pick kung saan bumida ang mga taga-Bagumbayan, Taguig sa game arena.

Sa Act-Song, si Vhong Navarro umeksena kina Darren Espanto at Cianne Dominguez. Si Ryan Bang naman, “binasted” si Cianne? Sa dulo ng laro, si Mckoy ang panalo at umabante sa jackpot round.

Sa dulo ng laro, si Mckoy ang panalo at umabante sa jackpot round. Ang raketbniya, magbenta ng matatamis na pastries. Matamis din kaya ang maging kapalaran niya at maiuwi ang POT money?

title: WALANG WINNER TODAY sa Miss Q&A?!
description:
Sa pamamagitan ng kanyang awitin, ginamit ni TNT champ JM Yosures ang boses para imulat ang mata ng mga Pilipino, na lahat tayo ay may kontribusyon upang labanan ang kahirapan.

Dahil brand new ang week, may fresh batch of "Miss Q and A" candidates na nag-hello sa "It's Showtime."Ganap na ganap sa puksaan at talakan sina Binibining Dana, Jinger Aman Villamor, at Wynzhl Bansagan.

Pagkatapos ng Tumpak Ganern round, sina Jinger at Binibining Dana ang nakalusot, samantalang si Wynzhl ay umuwing lotlot" Anong mas ayaw mo kapag matutulog, ‘yung may maingay na aso o may katabi na amoy aso?" ang tanong na nabunot ni Jinger. Sakto because she's a loving fur mom! Pero mukhang hindi sumakto ang sagot niya kina hurados Bianca Umali, Ralph de Leon, at Nicole Cordoves. Gano'n din ang komento nila sa sagot ni Binibining Dana, na tumalak tungkol sa mga bestie na snaky.

Biro ni Vice Ganda, parang walang winner today. Pero maya-maya pa ay kinoronahan ang totoong reyna. Sa araw na 'to, si Jinger ang itinanghal na Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era.

Samantala, ginamit din ni Brent Manalo ang boses para 'tumalak' sa ipapatayong AI and semiconductor industrial hub, Pax Silica, sa kanyang hometown sa Tarlac. At sa pagbabalik ni Darren, naipit si Jackie Gonzaga, na sa sobrang haba ng hair ay balik-love triangle with Darren at Brent.

Sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, nagpahinga muna ang mga players na masahista. Minalas no'ng una pero bumawi ang swerte kay player Budang, na nabunot para sa jackpot round. No'ng una ay ipinaglaban niya ang POT para sa inang may cancer, at kapatid na may sakit sa puso. Pero, minsan panalo na rin ang sigurado, kaya sa dulo, forda Li-Pot na si Budang sa halagang P30,000. Sinunod niya si nanay.

title: Miss Q&A: Thalia, na-STEAL ang pwesto kay Julia
description:
Maki-sound trip na with with the musical duo Music Travel Love, na binubuo ng magkaatid na Bob and Clint Moffatt, na mula sa pop-rock band The Moffatts, ang mga OG crushies ng '90s girlies. Times three ang kilig dahil kasama pa ang kanilang triplet brother na si Dave.

Signal No.5 ang pagbuhos ng wit ng mga "Miss Q and A" candidates. Sa June 25 episode, sina Julia Masungsong, Thalia Marimar Fulgoso Meiy Amor, at Mama Mama ang best in recitation, talak kung talak for the whole nation. Kapag nagkandabuhol-buhol ang sagot, idaan na lang sa conviction!

Si Mama Mama, mabilis na nakalusot sa 'Tumpak Ganern' round matapos maibigay ang tamang English term ng 'hikab.' Pero nagkagulo ang everyone sa ikalawang katanungan na may kinalaman sa spelling!

Nilaban ni Julia ang sagot niya sa spelling ng “vaccum” na “victory-a-c-u-u-m” pero hindi ito tinanggap dahil, paliwanag ni Vice Ganda, hindi letra ang “victory.”

Sa 'Wit Lang' round, nabunot ni Mama Mama ang tanong na kung ano ang gagawin niya kapag nanaginip siya na kumakain siya ng masarap pero paggising ay may waiter na naniningil. Si Thalia naman, bahagyang natigilan sa kalagitnaan ng talak, pero effective naman na pambawi ang kanyang cute na ngiti.

Samantala, expect heavy downpour ng kagandahan sa pagdating ng espesyal na hurado, si Miss Universe 2025 3rd runner-up Ahtisa Manalo. Thunderstorm advisory: Posibleng bumuhos ang selos! Si Vice Ganda, para bang 'na-jelly' sa pagpansin ni Ahtisa sa joke ng kanyang hubby. Hayaan mo na, Meme! Tumawa lang naman, eh!

Inspirasyon na dala ng mga AUsome parents na bumida sa 'Laro Laro Pick' game arena. Sila ang mga mapagmahal at matatatag na magulang na may anak na PWD (Person With Disability). Hinangaan ng Madlang People ang tibay ng puso ni Nanay Lele, na ang anak ay bulag at may autism. Doble pa ang hirap ni nanay dahil solo lang siya sa buhay, at walang sustentong nakukuha sa dating asawa. Pero doble rin ang pagmamahal na ibinubuhos sa anak niya.

Kahit nagbabadya ang buhos ng ulan sa kalangitan, hindi suspended ang pagpapalabas ng 'Showtime The Movie,' este ng mga eksena sa 'You Gotta Lyric.' With special participation ni

Ralph de Leon ang breakup scene kung saan ang kagandahan ni Lassy, mas lumamang sa alindog ni Cianne.

All-star cast naman ang mala-"Princess Sara" na eksena kung saan bumida si Vice Ganda. Siya si Vice Sara! At ang leading man ni Meme, syempre, si Ion Perez bilang Peter C. Walang nakaligtas sa lupit ni Jhong Hilario bilang Miss Minchin, na pabirong pinag-trip-an si Meme at ginawang 'fur baby.' Hanggang sa ang eksenang pagtatanan, nauwi sa habulan (nadapa si Miss Minchin!) at basaan! Walang Unkabogable card dito, dahil kahit si Vice Ganda, ayun, basang-basa!

Pagkatapos ng magulong aktingan, naging seryoso ang usapan nina Vice at Lele sa jackpot round. Si Meme, nagbigay ng payo sa mga nagpaplanong magkaroon ng anak. Mabilisan na ang tawaran, si Meme na mismo ang nanghikayat kay Nanay Lele na mag-POT.

Dahan-dahang binasa ni Meme ang POT question, na nasagot ni Nanay Lele nang tama kaya sa kanya ang P100,000 jackpot money! Bumuhos ang luha ni Nanay Lele at napayakap kay Meme.

title: Vice ayaw pabalikin si Bong Bong sa Miss Q&A?!
description:
Limang ‘accla’ na maririkit ang nagpasiklaban ng wit sa isa na namang masayang weekly finals ng Miss Q and A sa "It's Showtime."

Bago ang talakan, enjoy muna ang mga Miss Q and A weekly finlists at ang mga hosts na sina Vhong Navarro, Vice Ganda, at Jhong Hilario sa kuwentuhan. Dahil Sabado at bihis na bihis ang mga 'fersons,' hindi maiwasan ang OOTD puksaan. Si Vice, napagtulungan dahil sa suot niyang shorts na basketball uniform daw, at boots na pampulis kalawakan. Si Jhong naman, very Gen Z at trendy sa buhok na kulot. Hirit naman ni Vice sa suot na nude vest ni Vhong, parang action star ang pormahan pero may Barbie arms.

Samantala, na-miss ni Vice Ganda ang pagkikita nila ni candidate Bong Bong, na lumaban noong August 13. Papayag nga ba si Meme na rumesbak si Bong Bong?

Idol talaga sa chukchakan sina Miss Q&A weekly finalists Jurexa Caparino, Nadimunyo Lustre, Miss Pau Ellarina Ortiz, Rocky Cueva, at CK Alcaraz Zarfl.

Si Nadimunyo ang unang naligwak sa kompetisyon, samantalang ang apat ay umabante sa Wit Lang. Mula naman sa apat, ang Top 2 na sina Rocky at CK ang nag-face off sa final round, Beklamation, kung saan pareho nilang hinarap ang tanong na, "Ano ang mas mahirap—tanggapin ang ayaw mo o tanggihan ang gusto mo?"

Mahusay sila sa time management habang pinagsasabay ang sports at academics. Pero sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, maging champion kaya ang mga student athletes?

Si player Angel-El, may pag-demo ng karate moves. Ingat lang baka matamaan ng sumisipa niyang galawan! Sumisipa rin ang good vibes sa aktingan round na You Gotta Lyric. Ito na ba 'yung DaCkie in an LQ scene? Ay, sina Ryan Bang at Teddy Corpuz pala!

Bigo ang mga natirang players na mka-survive hanggang dulo, kaya bumunot ng isang lucky manlalaro. Parang buzzer beater shot, biglang nabuhay ang kapalaran ni Jayvee. Hindi man niya nasagot ang POT question, hanga pa rin si Vice Ganda sa fighting spirit ni Jayvee at sa sipag ng mga kabataang atleta, kaya naisip niyang regaluhan ng extra P1,000 ang bawat players.

title: Berlin Transgression
description: Berlin Transgression tells the stories of transvestite, drag and transgender artists who struggle between two genders, two identities, two lives. This project sheds light on the day and night life of the artists who perform mostly at local gay bars and fetish clubs. These artists allow us not only backstage but also into their homes where they open their hearts to us about their deepest dreams and desires. We follow their fight to tear down a new, invisible, wall which is the basis of our isolation.

title: Vice, sinala ang TALENT ng mga Miss Q&A candidates
description:
Paligayahin muna ang mga puso sa good vibes na dala ng "It's Showtime" family, at chill jamming with "The Voice USA" champ Sofronio Vasquez, na bagay na bagay sa cuddle weather ang boses.

Kuwentuhan na lang tayo, biro ni Vice Ganda sa mga kaibigang sina Vhong Navarro at Jhong Hilario bago magsimula ang 'Miss Q and A.' Napa-reminisce ang trio sa mga kuwentong ulan at kuwentong baha nila noong kabataan.

Full of hope naman ang talak nina Miss Q and A candidates Namssie Lopez, Raine Garcia, at Eron Tuico Arganosa. Bago ang talakan, sa talent muna sila nagpasiklaban! Pati sina hurados Nicole Cordoves, Brent Manalo, at Karylle napilitang mag-sample ng talent!

Sina Namssie at Raine ang sumalang sa witty tanungan sa Wit Lang round. Para kay Namssie, "Alin ang mas pipiliin mo, pangit ang araw mo pero maganda ka, o maganda ang araw mo pero pangit ka?" Nabunot naman ni Raine ang tanong na, "Anong mas ikakaglit ng sinaing, 'yung nasunog siya o hindi na-on ang rice cooker?"

Dakila ang kanilang hanapbuhay bilang mga kasambahay. Kaya deserve nila ang mag-relax muna at magpahinga sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Makihula at maki-POT at Li-Pot kasama ang mga kasambahay ng San Pedro, Laguna.

Naantig si Vice sa kuwento ni player Wency, na sa pamamagitan ng paglalaba at pagsisilbi sa mga amo ay nakapagpatapos ng mga anak sa kolehiyo. Naramdaman ni Vice ang saya ng isang inang nakapagpa-graduate ng anak sa pamamagitan ng sariling pawis at sakripisyo.

Binigyan ni Vice ng tig-sampung libo ang bawat kasambahay na naglaro sa game arena. Naiyak ang isang player sa ayuda ni Vice dahil, aniya, saktong nangangailangan siya ng pera upang makalipat ng tirahan.

Dahil walang naka-survive sa mga challenges, bumunot ng lucky player na makakabalik sa game arena. Si Ocel ang biniyayaan ng universe ng second chance. Umabot sa P30,000 ang Li-Pot offer ng "It's Showtime" hosts. Malaking bagay na ito kay Ocel, kaya naman "Li-Pot" ang kanyang sigaw!

Isang eliminated player naman ang nakakuha ng P50,000 dahil sa ibinigay na pagkakataon ni Vice Ganda na sagutin ang POT question.

title: Linda Walker natameme sa sagot ni Kelly sa Miss Q&A It's Showtime
description:
Loud ang cheers at concert feels sa June 16 episode ng "It's Showtime," as Ryan Bang performed some of the best OPM hits sa isang masayang birthdayprod, na nagpaindak sa mga manonood.

Araw-araw ay parang grand celebration ng mga 'beki' na hatid ay good vibes. Sa Day 2 ng pinakabagong season ng "Miss Q and A," muling umulan ng tawanan kasama ang sangkabaklaan.

Nagpasiklaban sina Contestant 1 Michelle Calamity, Contestant 2 Kelly Agustin, at Contestant 3 Linda Walker. Kung si Vice Ganda ang kahulma ni Michelle, si Jhong Hilario naman daw ang kamukha ni Contestant 2. At kung fairytale ang kuwento for today’s video, si Kelly ang prinsesang napapaligiran ng wicked stepsisters.

Sa unang round, ligwak si Contestant 1, pero pangako niya, she will return better and fiercer than ever. Sa pabonggahan naman ng wit sa ikalawang round, full of confidence ang pagsagot ni Linda, at pak na pak ang opinyon ni Kelly. Proving that she's got both beauty and brains, nasungkit ni Kelly ang bilib ng judges na sina Karylle, Ralph de Leon at Nicole Cordoves. Si Kelly ang itinanghal na Reyna Talak-Era of the day!

Palaki nang palaki ang papremyo sa game arena, kaya naman ganado sa Laro Laro Pick ang mga senior citizens ng Tandang Sora.

Agaw-eksena ang rakistang si Bro, na um-skip muna sa isang mahalagang pag-uwi sa probinsya para makapaglaro sa studio. Si Vice Ganda naman ang maintenance nina Lola Nene at Edith dahil makita lang siya, sapat na para sumaya!

Dahil ginalingan at kinapitan ang swerte, sa jackpot round, si Tatay Roger ang umabante. Pagpapataya ng 'ending' ang kanyang pinagkakakitaan. Katulad ng hanapbuhay ni tatay, kailangan sumugal para makuha ang jackpot money na P200,000.

Siguradong may isang lolo na happy dahil si tatay Roger ay may maiuuwing P30k, matapos tanggapin ang Li-Pot offer.

title: Sassa Gurl napadaan sa Miss Q and A
description:
Tayo'y always napapalingon sa kanyang mapulang blush, ang awrahan ni Sasa Gurl for today's video, deserve ng sash. Best in Costume 'yan? Ang Halloween, parang dumating in advance.

Humagupit na sa "It's Showtime" area of responsibility ang bumabagyong kagandahan at wit ng mga kandidata sa "Miss Q and A."

Kung costume party ito, effortless si Miss Q&A Kulot ng Cavite, ang 'bunot' ni Vice Ganda for today. Pinag-sample ng gymnastics at pinakanta, pero ang hindi niya naipakita ay 'yung talent na kumagat ng bakal. Isa pang talent niya ay pasayahin ang Madlang People sa charisma niyang kamahal-mahal.

Umuwi man siyang 'lotlot' sa kompetisyon, nasungkit naman niya ang puso ng buong nation. Samantala, sina Chloe Castillo ng Isabela at Rhed Sicuan ng Las Pinas ang umabante sa Wit Lang round kung saan tuluyan nilang pinakawalan ang fierce na skill sa talakan.

Para kina hurado Max Collins, Brent Manalo, at Nicole Cordoves, mas matimbang ang bilang ng sagot ni Rhed. Siya ang Miss Q and A Reyna TalakEra of the day.

Susuyuin ng mga taga-Manuyo Dos, Las Pinas ang swerte upang masungkit nila ang Laro Laro Pick POT money sa “It’s Showtime” July 9 episode.

Enjoy ang hosts sa chikahan with Tin, na pangarap maging pulis noong kabataan pero ngayon makeup na ang kanyang fantasy. Kakaiba naman ang nickname ni Meow, ang solo parent na raketera queen.

Samantala, now showing ang Episode 4 ng Memerimar sa act-song portion ng You Gotta Lyric round. Si Sergio (Vhong Navarro) nagselos dahil para bang mas mahal ni Memerimar (Vice Ganda) si Fulgoso (Lassy). Dumating naman sina Senyora Angelika (Jhong Hilario) at Inocencia (MC) upang makipagsundo kay Memerimar. Pero ang batian, nauwi sa bugbugan!

Sa jackpot round, mabilisan ang naging tawaran nang tanggapin agad ni Lenlen ang Li-Pot offer na P30,000. Malaking tulong na kasi ito pra sa therapy ng anak niyang nasa autism spectrum.

title: Miss Q&A Mentoy ibinahagi ang 'traumatic' experience
description:
Stay safe and stay dry, Madlang People! Kung malakas man ang buhos ng ulan, stay home muna as much as possible. "It's Showtime" and chill muna sabay sayaw ng moves na nakaka-"Oooh Lala!" Kaninong pambato ang panalo sa "Oooh Lala Baby" dance for today's video?

With full energy para ang banter ay mas havey, Vice Ganda hosted the Miss Q and A segment with Jhong Hilario at Vhong Navarro. Kung na-miss n'yo ang bardagulan at puksaan ng trio, heto na, walang kulang!

Sa haba man ng kuwentuhan with candidates Divine Geralde, Vavaing Vurdado, at Mentoy Alexa Ang, sa Tumpak Ganern round pa rin ang tuloy.

Struggle is real ang ma ‘accla’ sa tawag sa baby Elephant, at pati sa lugar sa Bulacan kung saan sumasayaw ang mga babaeng humihiling na magka-anak. At ang iconic quote ni Julius Caesar, nabago na pala?!

Hirit ni Meme Vice, "Ang sakit sa bangs!" Pero bumawi naman sa Wit Lang round ang dalawang kandidatang pasok sa chukchakan, sina Mentoy at Vavaing Vurdado. Parang bumaliktad ang mga pangyayari, dahil ang performance ni Mentoy, bawing-bawi! Satisfied at masaya si Meme!Sa dulo, wagi si Mentoy bilang Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era of the day.

Kasintapang ng kape ang fighting spirit ng mga baristang sumalang sa game arena kung saan sanib pwersa sina Vice Ganda at Karylle with Tyang Amy Perez.

Parang kape na ayaw mong tigilan, 'amats' naman ni Vice Ganda ang intern ng programa na biglang napasali pa sa aktingan. Samantala, para bang hindi basta aktingan lang ang hugot ni Ryan Bang kay Kim Chiu sa isang eksena. Hopia ba talaga?!

Saktong timpla ng swerte at diskarte ang mayroon si Ver, kaya sa jackpot round, siya ang umabante. Sumugal si Ver sa POT question, na may kinalaman tungkol sa kapeng barako.

title: Emma Tiglao umupo bilang Miss Q and A hurado
description:
I-on ang playlist at maki-sound trip with hip-hop artist J Rose, na ipinarinig ang bago niyang single at ibinahagi ang kuwento sa likod nito.

Makitawa naman sa mga kandidatang laban na laban sa Miss Q and A. Sa kanilang mga talak, atensyon mo'y mahahatak! Palaban sa puksaan sina Andrea Lim ng Pampanga, Rhian Orain ng Valenzuela, at Pau Chiu ng Manila.

Ang pangalan ni Candidate No. 3, inspired by Chinita Princess Kim Chiu, na 'peg' niya at idolo. Pero sa paningin ni Vice Ganda, hindi naman si Kim ang kanyang nakikita. Para bang deja vu, namalikmata si Meme at nakita si Tado! Biro niya, "Si Candidate #3 ay nakaaway ko no'ng Season 1." Baka ito na nga ang 'closure' na inaabangan.

Hirit ni Meme, "Mga bakla, aral-aral din." Pero sa hinaba-haba man ng kulitan, may dalwang kandidata na umabante sa second round, at ito ay sina Andrea at Pau. Ang tanong kay Andrea, "Papayag ka ba na marami kang pera pero na kay Vice Ganda?" At si Pau naman, natanong kung papayag siyang maging doktor kahit madali siyang mahawa ng mga sakit.

Pagkatapos ng WIT Lang, si Andrea ang pinusuan nina hurado Karylle, Brent Manalo, at Miss Grand International 2025 Emma Tiglao, at itinanghal na Reyna TalakEra of the day.

Sa araw na 'to, mga taga-Mahabang Parang, Angono Rizal ang bumida sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Kapag nagsama-sama naman ang Showtime hosts sa 'You Gotta Lyric' round, ibig sabihin, masaya ang aktingan. Si Lassy, pinagtulungan na buhatin. Teka, saan n'yo siya dalahen?

Best friends ni Christian ang mga alagang baboy dahil sila ang nagdadala sa kanya ng swerte at kabuhayan. Kaya 'pag nakuha niya ang P100,000 sa paglalaro sa jackpot round, ang mga alagang baboy, sure na madadagdagan.

title: Miss Q&A Lucky, may love advice sa co-candidate na NBSB
description:
Pagkatapos ng kanyang historic win sa 'Tawag Ng Tanghalan' Ika-10 Taon, noong nakaraang linggo, nagbabalik si Yannie Paul Basical sa entablado upang muling iparinig ang tinig na nangibabaw sa TNT stage.

Ang mga beki sa "Miss Q and A," parang naka-unli cups of coffee sa taas ng energy. Sa rampahan pa lang ay to the maximum level na ang bardagulan ng mga contestants—Queen Angie ng Rizal, Jerica Perater ng Leyte, at Lucky Rosales Collins ng Manila.

No'ng isang araw, may napagdudahan ang kabaklaan. At parang déjà vu, mayro'ng muntik nang 'imbestigahan' for today's video. Ang "It's Showtime" hosts, parang duda kung 19 years old ba talaga si Contestant #2!

Promise, bagets pa siya, kaya nga hindi pa nagkaka-jowa! At para ipa-feel naman kay Jerica ang tamis ng pumapag-ibig, siya'y pinakilig ni Ryan Bang, ang ating 'oppa,' sa isang ekena na nagtapos sa slow-mo moment ala K-Drama.

At parang slow-mo rin ang performance ng mga kandidata sa TumPak Ganern round. Sina Lucky at Queen Angie naman ang nagtalakan sa ‘Wit Lang’ kung saan pumili sila ng magkaibang katanungan.

Isandaang libo ang pwedeng mapunta sa maswerteng taga-Cupang, Mutinlupa na makakarating sa dulo ng Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Pagdating sa aktingan, all-star cast ang eksenang digmaan. Walang nakapaghanda sa 'props' na dala ni Vice Ganda. Ang mga hosts, hindi na nakaiwas! Si Meme may mga dalang 'pasabog' at panlaban, kaya ang digmaan ay nauwi sa katatawanan!

Sa dami ng nangyari, si player Ali ang kinapitan ng swerte. Ang Li-Pot offer, itinodo na sa P30K! Alin ang pipiliin ni Ali?

title: Miss Q&A: Mga pamahiin sa pagsali sa pageants
description:
Sa dami ng nangyayari sa paligid, kailangan natin ng good news at good vibes para i-reset ang ating isip. Dito sa "It's Showtime," happiness overload ang mga eksenang mapapanood.

Isang pagbati ang ipinarating ng It's Showtime family sa 21-year-old world tennis champion na si Alex Eala, na gumawa ng kasaysayan sa mundo ng tennis matapos makuha ang kauna-unahang WTA title para sa Pilipinas nang talunin niya si world No. 3 Jessica Pegula ng United States sa 2026 Mubadala DC Open, na ginanap sa Washington D.C.

Mula sa isang alamat sa mundo ng sports, isang alamat sa larangan ng P-Pop din ang bumisita. Sinimulan ng P-Pop favorite Alamat ang episode with a performance of their track, "Sinigang," na inihain ng grupo specially for you!

Bawal ang nega, pero welcome dito si Negi, ang guest co-host of the day, na join sa pakikipagkulitan nina Jhong Hilario at Ogie Alcasid sa Miss Q&A candidates.

May pasok, as in pasok sa banga ang wit at pagrampa nina Miss Q&A Cheska Deyn, Leo Castillo, at Angelbert Castill. At pasok sa banga ang mga paandar nila't special skills. Sina Cheska at Angelbert ang umabante sa Round 2, Wit Lang, kung saan sagot nila'y sure na sure, showing grace under pressure.

Hindi suspended ang swerte sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Sumugod s rumaragasang god vibes at papremyo ang Madlang Players mula Pamplona, Las Pinas City.

Kapag 'Kim' ang pangalan, maganda talaga ang ngiti n'yan! Dahil sa magaan na awra ni player Kim, isang 21-year-old daddy, nag-enjoy ang hosts na makipagkuwentuhan sa kanya tungkol sa trabaho't pamilya.

Enjoy rin ang Madlang People sa libreng 'sine' sa FUNanghalian. Sa Act-Song portion ng You Gotta Lyric round, may horror at comedy, at may kilig hatid ng tambalang DaCKie!

title: After We're Over
description: One fateful Saturday, Zelzah (Adrienne Rose White) receives a call out of the blue from her ex, Sazerac (Chris Mollica). It's the first she's heard from him in the year since he broke her heart and left St. Louis to move home to Long Island. Wearily, Zelzah decides to grab breakfast with him, which turns into a day-long exploration of the city of St. Louis - and their failed relationship. Over the course of the day, the film slips in time. As the two come together in the present, we see them fall apart in the past, their memories bleeding into their current conversations. While visiting some of the city's most famous landmarks, they discuss love, death, sex, politics, memory, and what we owe to each other and ourselves, as well as the ultimate question: can they begin again after they're over?

title: Terry R. Wickham's Anomaly
description: A paranormal research team of three men investigates a remote location long rumored to be haunted. They vanish without a trace. A female police officer investigating the case befriends three women connected with the missing men. Together they search for answers surrounding the researchers' frightening disappearance. A force beyond anything they could ever imagine enters their lives to prevent them from learning the truth. Each of their destinies is forever altered following a series of terrifying encounters with the unknown. In the end, they must test the bands of their friendship and survive the night in one final showdown with the malevolent beings intent on their destruction.

title: We're Still Together
description: Chris can't get along with anyone. When he's attacked in the street Bobby, a manic single dad, jumps in. The two set out into the Montreal night together crashing parties, meeting girls, and eventually seeing Bobby's estranged daughter - Chris soon discovers that the underside to Bobby's charm is a self-destructive streak. Over the course of the night, as they come to know each other they try not to lose themselves.

title: Prescription R
description: Richard is on the run from Glasgow's criminal underworld, after the collapse of its drug manufacturing operation. When he turns to his friend for help things will take a dark turn for the worst, before descending into chaos.

title: C(r)ook
description: A killer for the Russian Mafia in Vienna wants to retire and write a book about his passion - cooking. The mafia godfather suspects treason.

title: 307-r
description: '307-r' treats about a mysterious soldier put in a post-apocalyptic scenery; he has no name and, unfortunately, he finds himself inside the humid torture room of the enemy, who will force him to face the demons of a tormented mind. The soldier lives in a so-called limbo of a future society where the one and the only law which is observed is "homo homini lupus"; he plays his personal chess game in a constant balance between the physical violence and the psychological torture, in a delirious climax whose highest point is an external act of becoming conscious of the situation. How long can a man resist under torture? How far can a man push his limits? But, above all, who is the mole?

title: R-15 S1-S15
description: Takuto Akutagawa has a special ability for writing porn novels. He applies to Hirameki Gakuen a high school which only accepts people with "Unique" talent. Now he must chase his dream and direct his classmates to win an interclass competition. All while trying to create the prefect harem.

title: Movement (R)evolution Africa
description: In an astonishing exposition of choreographic fomentation, nine African choreographers tell stories of an emergent art form and their diverse and deeply contemporary expressions of self. Stunning choreography and riveting critiques challenge stale stereotypes of "traditional Africa" to unveil soul-shaking responses to the beauty and tragedy of 21st century Africa.

title: Patel S.I.R
description: Subhash Patel (Jagapathi Babu), a retired army officer, takes on a group of drug traffickers. ACP Catherine, a corrupt lady officer, vows to find out the reason behind his mission.

title: R U the Boy?
description: Scandocious J.r. has seen the heights of his career being appreciated for his musical talents as an openly gay rapper/singer. The only thing he hasn't been able to accomplish is finding true love. To make this distant dream a reality Scandocious J.r. enlists his closest friends to help him find Mr right. Put on your seat belts, and get ready to find out if he can find his one, and only!

title: S.O.N.S. (Sons of Nanay Sabel)
description: S.O.N.S. (Sons of Nanay Sabel)

title: Camel(s)
description: An unremarkable man in his forties and a female acquaintance. They talk, eat, and though both are married elsewhere, have sex.

title: S' agapo
description: A sensitive young woman falls for an older man, a doctor, but has to deal with the onset of his terminal illness.

title: Sluchay s patsanom
description: Yura - a guy from the workers' quarter far from politics - by the will of fate finds himself drawn into the maelstrom of political events.

title: Allegro s ognyom
description: In June 1941, the fascists tried to block the Black Sea Fleet in Sevastopol, throwing new top-secret magnetic-acoustic mines into the channel. To neutralize this formidable weapon, a special group of volunteers was created.

title: Assassin(s)
description: Old professional killer Wagner seeks someone to teach what he knows as long as he is already dying, and he chooses Max, young and passionless thief to be his successor.

title: S#*! Talk
description: We follow the lives of best friends, Sav and Ray, as they hilariously navigate their way through their 20-somethings.

title: CHAMPION(S)
description: As promising young athletes, they share the same crazy dream : to be at the 2024 Olympics. CHAMPION(S) is a docuseries shot inside INSEP, the French Olympic training center in Paris to tell a story that mixes hopes, doubts and the weight of sacrifices.

title: Dívka s muslí
description: Thirteen-year-old Vendula (Dita Kaplanová) dozes off at school and dreams about her parents riding in a carriage dressed in their wedding clothes. The young teacher is angry with the girl who has already failed a year, and has no idea that she is looking after three younger half-brothers. They all have a different father and their mother (Evelyna Steimarová) comes home noisy and drunk every day, often accompanied by a man. Early in the morning, Vendula helps her mother clean offices, and sometimes has to do the cleaning all by herself. Her eldest brother Libor is good at school and blindly adores his mother. Jeník is a talented flute player and much more cynical. The youngest Venousek is still a toddler. The only one who is cared of is Vendula by her father (Ladislav Frej), who has divorced his confirmed alcoholic wife years ago and has another daughter in his new family. All his attempts to persuade Vendula to move in with them are in vain. The girl is selflessly trying to keep the family together.
